name: Bloodfeather Belt
summary: In northern Teldrassil, Bloodfeather harpies wear crude leather belts as they crowd the Oracle Glade. Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak collects them as proof that the nearby nests have been cleared.

sections.title: Trophies from the Nests
sections.body: Bloodfeather harpies have built aggressive nests in the boughs around the Oracle Glade. Their presence threatens the ancient Oracle Tree and blocks travel through northern Teldrassil. After the flock ambushed and killed a runner carrying reports to Darnassus, Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak called on travelers to strike at the nests. The belts taken from fallen harpies show that their numbers are being culled and the paths are being secured, so messages can reach the capital again.

faq.q: Why does Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak want these belts?
faq.answer: Arynia Cloudsbreak and her small detachment of Sentinels guard the sacred Oracle Tree against the nearby Bloodfeather nests. After the harpies killed a messenger bound for Darnassus, Arynia asks travelers to bring back belts as proof that they are clearing the nests and thinning the flock.

faq.q: Where do Bloodfeather Belts come from?
faq.answer: Bloodfeather harpies in the trees and crags around the Oracle Glade in northern Teldrassil carry these belts. Every kind in the flock carries one, including wind witches, sorceresses, rogues, and furies.

faq.q: Why are harpies a problem in the Oracle Glade?
faq.answer: The harpies have nested close to the Oracle Tree, an ancient tree that watches over the health of the World Tree. Their aggression isolates the Sentinels guarding the glade and violently disrupts messages bound for Darnassus.

angles.text: The Bloodfeather coven has defiled Teldrassil’s natural canopy. Reclaiming the Oracle Glade from their nests is a duty for any protector of the Kaldorei homeland.
Helping Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak lets vital reports from Teldrassil’s ancient trees reach Darnassus’s leaders without interruption.
